mapper.select: SELECT P.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd, P.PROGRM_FILE_NM AS progrmFileNm, P.PROGRM_STRE_PATH AS progrmStrePath, P.PROGRM_NM_CODE AS progrmNmCode, M.MESSAGE_CN AS message_cn, P.PROGRM_URL AS progrmUrl, P.PROGRM_DC AS progrmDc, P.USE_FL AS useFl, P.CREATION_ID AS creationId, P.CREATION_DT AS creationDt, P.UPDATE_ID AS updateId, P.UPDATE_DT AS updateDt FROM CM_PROGRM P LEFT JOIN ( SELECT LANG_KEY, MESSAGE_CN FROM CM_MESSAGE_LANG WHERE CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND LANG_CODE = #{langCode} ) M ON M.LANG_KEY = P.PROGRM_NM_CODE WHERE P.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND P.PROGRM_FILE_NM = #{progrmFileNm}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CM_PROGRM ( CMPNY_CD, PROGRM_FILE_NM, PROGRM_STRE_PATH, PROGRM_NM_CODE, PROGRM_URL, PROGRM_DC, USE_FL, CREATION_ID, CREATION_DT ) VALUES ( #{cmpnyCd}, #{progrmFileNm}, IFNULL(#{progrmStrePath}, ''), #{progrmNmCode}, #{progrmUrl}, #{progrmDc}, IFNULL(#{useFl}, 'Y'), #{creationId}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE CM_PROGRM SET PROGRM_STRE_PATH = #{progrmStrePath}, PROGRM_NM_CODE = #{progrmNmCode}, PROGRM_URL = #{progrmUrl}, PROGRM_DC = #{progrmDc}, USE_FL = #{useFl}, UPDATE_ID = #{updateId}, UPDATE_DT = NOW() WHERE CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND PROGRM_FILE_NM = #{progrmFileNm}
